## Navigation Lights

Standards are divided into 3 groups (by length of the ship/boat/vessel):

### < 12m (48 blocks)

[![Ship Standards Nav Light Class1](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/6/6b/Ship_Standards_Nav_Light_Class1.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/400?cb=20190515085518)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/6/6b/Ship_Standards_Nav_Light_Class1.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190515085518)

### 12m - 50m (48 - 200 blocks)

[![Ship Standards Nav Light Class2](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/be/Ship_Standards_Nav_Light_Class2.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/400?cb=20190515085542)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/b/be/Ship_Standards_Nav_Light_Class2.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190515085542)

### > 50m (200 blocks)

[![Ship Standards Nav Light Class3](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/e/e0/Ship_Standards_Nav_Light_Class3.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190515092542)
